items: Automate the tasks that are repetitive, predictable and time-consuming to do by hand, since that's where automation pays off fastest as you add locations.
The areas restaurants automate most are ordering and drive-thru, customer support, ticket management, inventory, and labor and scheduling, so match each tool to one of these jobs.
Budget per location, and expect enterprise plans, integrations and custom workflows to cost more as your chain grows.
For customer support, Momos' AI agent Alfie reads, categorizes and answers each review within minutes, while Rockie ranks locations against brand standards so headquarters knows where to focus.
